root_cause.text: The mlx5e driver for striding RQ failed to increment page fragment reference counts on all original XDP buffer fragments when an XDP multi-buf program dropped tail fragments (via bpf_xdp_pull_data or bpf_xdp_adjust_tail), causing a page pool reference count underflow when releasing the page.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message state that after the previous fix (87bcef158ac1) the driver "skips counting this fragment" (the tail fragment dropped by the XDP program), leading to "pp_ref_count=63" while the driver tries to release all 64 fragments, resulting in a negative reference count error and a WARNING splat. The patch fixes by reverting to counting all original fragments (head_page to frag_page) for XDP actions (XDP_TX, XDP_REDIRECT, XDP_PASS).

vuln_statements.content: xdp_update_skb_frags_info(skb, frag_page - head_page, sinfo->xdp_frags_size, truesize, xdp_buff_get_skb_flags(&mxbuf->xdp));

bic_trace_step.reason: In the XDP_DROP/TX path (after mlx5e_xdp_handle returns true), the code marks only the first sinfo->nr_frags fragments in the skip_release_bitmap, based on the possibly reduced count after the XDP program modifies fragments via bpf_xdp_pull_data or bpf_xdp_adjust_tail.
